data.body: FIXED 2026-05-24 commit 0ab313eb37 (branch recovery-3a03/c916-label-fix; PR pending via merge-to-main). Fix: replaced ACLI singular --label flag with --from-json + labelsToAdd. Added remove_label counterpart using labelsToRemove. Both use --yes to skip the interactive confirmation prompt. Empirically additive against DIG-3802. Pinned via 33 contract regression tests in tests/scripts/test_bridge_acli_field_coverage.py (TestAcliContractRegression class). Also added defensive _sanitize_label + _sanitize_summary against untrusted user input. Validation audit agent dispatched to independently cross-check the hardened implementation against authoritative ACLI docs + GitHub prior art.
